title: Latvian temporary residence for an investment in a company's share capital (EUR 50,000 or EUR 100,000, plus EUR 10,000 to the state budget)

sources.title: Immigration Law, 27. pants (1) 10): up to two years for EUR 50,000 or EUR 100,000 invested in a company's share capital and EUR 10,000 paid to the state budget; the company's size and yearly taxes
Immigration Law, 27. pants (3): in the cases of the first part a family member of the foreigner may also request a temporary residence permit for the term of the foreigner's permit
Immigration Law, 1. pants (1) 8) ģimenes loceklis: the spouse, the minor children of the third-country national or of the spouse (wards included) and persons under curatorship
Immigration Law, 27. pants (7) and (8): a citizen of Belarus, and a citizen of the Russian Federation, has no right to request a temporary residence permit under point 10 of the first part
Immigration Law, 1. pants (1) 21) and 29) and 2. pants: a third-country national holds no EU, EEA or Swiss citizenship; the law sets the entry and residence of third-country nationals
Immigration Law, 29. pants (1) and (3): a repeated permit while the conditions last; after five years of residence on this ground, EUR 2,000 paid to the state budget on receiving the repeated permit
Immigration Law, 33. pants (1) 1): the Office examines the documents for a temporary residence permit and answers within 30 days
Immigration Law, 28. pants: the Cabinet may suspend the issue of permits under 27. pants (1) 10) for up to five years for nationals of the third countries it names
Cabinet Regulations No. 731 of 2024 on the state fee for migration services, point 5.1: examining a temporary residence permit request in 30 days EUR 160, in 10 working days EUR 280, in 5 EUR 560
Civil Law, Part One (family law): art. 219, minority lasts until the age of 18; art. 221, a person who married before 18 is of age

requirements.title: Funds for the minimum investment of EUR 50,000 in a company's share capital and for the EUR 10,000 payment to the state budget (the investment is EUR 100,000 in a larger company)
Not a citizen of Russia or Belarus, whose citizens have no right to this permit
Not a citizen of an EU or EEA state or of Switzerland, Latvia included: only third-country nationals may request this permit

assessments.title: EUR 50,000: a company with at most 50 employees and a yearly turnover or balance sheet of at most EUR 10 million; EUR 100,000: over 50 employees and over EUR 10 million
For an investment in one company's share capital, permits go to at most 10 foreigners, each having made the investment and paid EUR 10,000 to the state budget
The permit stays valid only while the company pays at least EUR 40,000 in taxes each reporting year (EUR 100,000 for the larger company, its Latvian subsidiaries included)
The Cabinet may suspend these permits for up to five years for nationals of third countries it names; no such regulations were found on 2026-11-11

dependents.title: Spouse, unless an EU, EEA or Swiss citizen, who needs no permit under this law
Children under 18 who have not married, unless EU, EEA or Swiss citizens, who need no permit under this law; a person of 18 or more under curatorship: possible
The spouse's children under 18 who have not married, unless EU, EEA or Swiss citizens, who need no permit under this law; a person of 18 or more under curatorship: possible

costs.title: Minimum investment in the share capital of a company within the small-company limits
One-off payment to the state budget with the first application
State fee for examining the principal's temporary residence permit request in 30 days: EUR 160 (EUR 280 in 10 working days, EUR 560 in 5)
State fee for examining each family member's temporary residence permit request in 30 days: EUR 160 (EUR 280 in 10 working days, EUR 560 in 5)
Payment to the state budget on receiving a repeated permit after five years of residence on this ground: EUR 2,000: possible

durations.title: The Office's answer on the temporary residence permit request, within 30 days of accepting all the documents
Temporary residence permit for up to two years, then a repeated permit while the conditions last
